propositions: GitHub Actions pytest matrix jobs advance to 99% progress then emit nothing for 1.7–4.3 hours until manual cancellation because the reusable workflow test job lacks a timeout-minutes bound and defaults to GitHub's 360-minute limit.

Gerrit patchsets 1129/1130/1131/1136 omit commit 96a0d5c3f and trigger unbounded per-blob lazy-fetch RPC sequences (~2.1 hours) during materialize_tree on shallow blobless clones; contemporaneous runs with the fix complete in 6–18 minutes.

FakeJiraClient.search_issues in test_jira_dc_transport.py ignores startAt/maxResults pagination parameters and returns the same non-empty issue list forever, causing test_comment_map_matches_the_shared_contract to timeout when _paged_search attempts unbounded iteration.
Manual cancellation of stuck matrix jobs clears the GitHub-hosted runner queue because all four cells occupy slots simultaneously and no job timeout causes automatic failure.
Production code paths in materialize_tree and Jira paging are unchanged; defects are contained to CI workflow configuration (missing timeout-minutes) and test-only FakeJiraClient pagination mock.
